title: Did a Mistaken Obituary Create the Nobel Prize?
topic: In 1888 French papers confused Alfred Nobel with his late brother Ludvig and branded him a 'merchant of death'; on 27 Nov 1895 he signed the will that created the prizes. Historians dispute how much the obituary mattered.
